notes: A table needs a header row (GFM): a lone delimiter row is text in all three (the reader sets MIN_HEADER_ROWS=1).

name: footnote definition
markdown:
A sourced claim[^src].

[^src]: Where it came from.

markdown:

name: full reference link with no definition
shortcut reference link with no definition
bare URL followed by a period
bare URL with a non-web scheme
notes: GFM autolinks only web (http(s)://, www.) and email addresses; any other scheme:// text stays text in all three (the reader unwraps flexmark's wider autolinks to match).

name: escaped footnote reference
markdown:
Not a note \[^1] here.

[^1]: Defined but never referenced.

name: HTML block
notes: By design (controller ruling 2026-11-01): the editor never injects page-authored HTML (spec 1 non-goal and anti-goal: an XSS path into the editor DOM). Live preview shows the block as muted source (cm-lp-html, spec 5.6); the preview pane renders without raw-HTML support (no rehype-raw, pinned by the plugin-stack drift test) so it shows escaped text. The reader renders it, sanitised.

name: plugin line
notes: The editor shows [{...}] markup as a labelled chip and decides nothing (spec 4; remarkWikiMarkup in the preview pane); only the server runs plugins, applies access rules and expands variables, so the reader shows their output and never the markup.
